newsitem.title: USA: Minet likely to boost Aon earnings--Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Minet likely to boost Aon earnings--Merrill.

text.p: The acquisition of London insurance broker Minet is likely to contribute to Aon Corp's earnings in 1998, a Merrill Lynch analyst said.
Aon earlier this month agreed to acquire Minet from St. Paul Cos Inc. The specific terms of the transaction were deemed immaterial to either party and were not disclosed.

However, Merrill Lynch analyst Jay Cohen in a recent research report said he believes the deal was struck at around net asset value. The net asset value of Minet is around $62 million, he said in the report.
He said he believes revenues at Minet are likely to be around $250 million following the months of uncertainty about its future.
Assuming Aon is able to achieve a five percent net margin, well below its own margin, the earnings pick-up would be $12.5 million, he said.
The net earnings gain would be in the $0.07 to $0.10 a share range.
Assuming the company can achieve a 10 percent margin, the earnings gain would be closer to $0.20 a share, he said.
Although the deal is likely to add to Aon's 1998 earnings, he said he was maintaining his estimate for the time being, until more detailed information is released.
Cohen currently estimates Aon's 1998 earnings at $4.80 a share.
